description: This file implements the MessageControl class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, message routing, and WebSocket communication, with dependencies on JSON messaging and external message output components.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class managing message control functionalities, including configuration, WebSocket export, and message routing.

classes.name: MessageControl::Config::NetworkNode
classes.description: Configuration class for network node settings, including port and binding address.

methods.name: MessageControl::MessageControl
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal members and message client factories.

methods.name: MessageControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service, sets up message output, and registers message control.

methods.name: MessageControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters message control, and releases the service.

methods.name: MessageControl::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: MessageControl::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel for communication.

methods.name: MessageControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages, either as raw strings or JSON elements.
